signals.text: Revenue grew 29% a year over 3 years vs 32% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 16% vs revenue at 29%: profits are lagging sales.
Operating margin compressed 249 bps in 3 years (12.0% → 9.5%).
Borrowings grew 3.3x in 3 years while equity grew 1.3x: growth is being funded with debt.
Working-capital days shortened by 23 days in 3 years (51 → 28).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 43% of reported profit: profits are not converting to cash, a red flag.

guidance.statement: We will stick with previous guidance of around 11% being center of gravity for jewellery margin.
guidance.quote: In the Investor Day and prior, we have said that more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.

guidance.statement: Damas would improve rapidly once the current situation gets over; overall portfolio will remain positive EBIT.
guidance.quote: And Damas would - is contingent upon the current situation. As soon as that situation gets over, I'm sure they will also improve pretty rapidly.

guidance.statement: We are targeting as always a double-digit aggressive growth in jewellery.
guidance.quote: if you're looking for what is that we are targeting, we are targeting, as always, a double-digit aggressive growth, and that's something which we shared even in the Investor Day.

guidance.statement: TEAL normalized margin would be gradually gravitating towards 12% to 15%, 16%.
guidance.quote: the normalized margin would be gradually gravitating towards 12% to 15%, 16%.

delivered.statement: Seen all-round growth across all businesses, brands, and subsidiaries with good volume and buyer growth.
Tanishq Mia Zoya normalized EBIT margin for the quarter was 10.9%.
Consolidated realization from customs duty rate increase was 407 crores.
Watches division normalized EBIT margin was 17.8% for the quarter.
Jewellery division buyer growth was 5% for the quarter.
CaratLane delivered 9.6% EBIT margin for the quarter.

calls.tone: Confident on demand and long-term growth, cautious on short-term gold price volatility and regional geopolitical impacts.

pushback.gist: Analysts pressed on whether guidance should be revisited given strong buyer growth and studded recovery.
Questions raised on the margin impact and business rationale of rolling out gold-for-cash exchange schemes.
Multiple analysts questioned sustainability of 18-20% growth if Y-o-Y gold price inflation turns zero.
Inquiries regarding aggressive discounting on diamond value and plain gold making charges by peers.

business.summary: Titan Company operates diverse consumer lifestyle businesses including Jewellery, Watches, Eyecare, and subsidiaries like CaratLane and TEAL, generating revenue through retail sales of branded lifestyle products and precision engineering.

segments.name: Jewellery
segments.note: Includes Tanishq, Mia, Zoya, CaratLane, and Rivaah brands.

guidance.statement: Jewellery sales growth targeted at 15% to 20% over a 3 to 5 year horizon.
guidance.quote: This is the general guidance that we have given that we should be able to sustain this kind of a growth irrespective of gold rate

guidance.statement: beYon lab-grown diamond brand to expand to 10 to 12 stores in 2 to 3 cities.
guidance.quote: our objective currently is very soon to scale up to the next step of 10 to 12 stores and then kind of see how that works

delivered.statement: Watches division reported overall growth of about 14% for the year, with analog growing 16%.
Jewellery business achieved an 8% resurgence in buyer growth in Quarter 4.
Jewellery business gained approximately 50 to 60 bps of market share in FY26 versus FY25.
CaratLane grew to the tune of 22%-23% for the period.

calls.tone: confident on long-term demand and formalization, cautious on short-term gold volatility and margins

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned potential import license delays from DGFT and rising gold metal loan costs.
Pressing on the international subsidiary losses of 82 crores and unpredictable GCC environment.
Skepticism on maintaining 11-11.5% domestic jewellery margins amidst surging gold prices.
Questions on whether CaratLane's lower growth was due to customers shifting to gold jewellery.

guidance.statement: CaratLane to gradually inch towards double-digit EBIT margin.
guidance.quote: gradually, CaratLane with the scale will start inching towards double-digit EBIT margin.

delivered.statement: Completed 67% stake acquisition of Damas, with consolidation starting from 1st January.
Consolidated labour code impact accounted for as INR152 crores exceptional item (INR138 crores standalone).
Jewellery division delivered strong 40% growth in Q3.
Eyewear domestic growth was close to 17.5% with omnichannel revenue growth at 11%.

calls.tone: Confident on demand and execution amidst gold price volatility, cautious on margin pressures.

pushback.gist: Analysts pressed on gross margin dips, pricing challenges, and the impact of rising gold prices.
Questions raised on flat buyer growth despite high revenue growth and rising average transaction values.
Inquiry into whether permanent discounting or making charge changes are required amid high gold prices.
Skepticism on international store profitability, margins, and store conversions to Tanishq.

guidance.statement: We target 35 to 40 new Tanishq store openings for the full year.
guidance.quote: purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect. 40 is the target.

guidance.statement: Watch margins will gradually revert towards the 15% to 16% band in the 1 to 2 year time frame.
guidance.quote: on a long term, I would say the kind of investments are required, mid-teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.

guidance.statement: By the time we end December, our growth rates should become better than the first half growth rates.
guidance.quote: by the time we end -- we come to YTD December, our growth rates should have become better than the first half growth rates.

guidance.statement: Eyewear business should close the year at a slightly higher number, between 13% to 14%.
guidance.quote: we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.

delivered.statement: Festive period for watches saw a 16% growth over last year.
CaratLane margins expanded 250 bps year-on-year to 10% in the quarter.
Tanishq added 9 domestic stores YTD September and 8 more in October.
High-value studded jewellery contributed 14% of overall business, 1 percentage point higher year-on-year.

calls.tone: confident on festive demand and growth, cautious on gold price volatility and margin impacts

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned consumer willingness, volume elasticity, and margin resilience amid parabolic gold price rises.
Pressed on flat-to-declining buyer growth trends and specific steps taken to bring buyers back.
Questioned the sharp increase in consolidated inventory and its impact on GML interest costs.
Asked whether TEAL has consumer business synergies and why it is not being demerged.
